author: WP10
summary: A short chapter on FNA3D as one CNA identity over FNA's driver-choosing library: compiled stock effects, no ShaderEffect, refusal of PBR draws, deferred handle release and resolve-on-unbind, and the evidence boundary. Current at 009d40f5. Tutorial 108 and Tutorial 114 already carried the identity, effect, refusal and oracle knowledge; the deferred-disposal and FNA3D_ResolveTarget lifetime rules were missing and were added as an expansion of the graphics backends internals page.

concepts.text: FNA3D is one CNA identity even though the FNA3D library chooses among its own drivers (SDL_GPU, Direct3D 11, OpenGL) at run time; the chosen driver is an implementation detail, pinned with FNA3D_FORCE_DRIVER, not an additional renderer identity.

The FNA3D family translates CNA buffers, textures, targets, queries and state into FNA3D handles and runs XNA's compiled stock-effect binaries through MojoShader, which makes it the always-on compatibility route for XNA Effect Framework programs.
FNA3D does not make CNA-authored shader source portable: it compiles no source at all, CustomEffects is an authored false, a ShaderEffect is constructed invalid and SpriteBatch ignores one.
tokens: ShaderEffect does not work on FNA3D

concepts.text: PBR engine-layer effects have no stock FNA binary; a PbrEffect or SkinnedPbrEffect draw is refused by effect type (RequirePbrShadingSupportEXT) before any buffer is bound instead of silently substituting BasicEffect or SkinnedEffect.

FNA3D-backed textures, render targets, renderbuffers, vertex and index buffers and effects release native handles only through FNA3D's deferred-disposal queue (FNA3D_AddDispose*), and only while the device is live, so a handle referenced by a queued batch outlives the C++ wrapper until the command stream no longer uses it.

Unbinding render targets on FNA3D first binds no targets and then calls FNA3D_ResolveTarget for each previously bound multisampled or mipped target, so the MSAA resolve and mip generation complete before a later draw can sample the texture.

FNA3D's evidence is source plus focused tests (adapter contract, formats, deterministic refusals) and a whole-corpus oracle run that gates only on rendering; pixel results are driver-specific (OpenGL on Mesa llvmpipe in the recorded run) and not a universal runtime pass.
tokens: That number is a measurement, not a grade

concepts.text: A future FNA3D qualification would record the chosen driver, prove a real present and readback, exercise compiled effects and run the shared parity fixtures without counting skipped tests as successes.
concepts.note: A proposal written for the book, not a TARGET fact; no CNA plan row or workflow at 009d40f5 implements it (no CI workflow builds FNA3D, per the verification section).
